権化: embodiment (as in "embodiment of evil"); incarnation; personification
張る: to stretch; to spread; to strain; to tighten
仰山: a lot; plenty; abundant; great many
揃う: to gather; to assemble; to be collected
つく: to take (seat, position, course, office, etc.); to assume; to be hired; to be employed
恐縮: feeling (much) obliged; being (very) grateful; being thankful
越える: to exceed; to surpass; to be more (than)
イメージ: image (in one's mind); impression; imagining; mental image
クレーム: claim (for compensation); customer complaint seeking compensation
犯す: to commit (e.g. crime); to perpetrate; to make (e.g. mistake)
保つ: to keep; to preserve; to hold; to retain
反面: (but) on the other hand; at the same time; then again; and yet
下げる: to lower; to reduce; to bring down
支える: to support; to prop; to sustain; to underlay
下座: coming down from one's seat and prostrating oneself (to pay obeisance)
